items.title: Global oil stocks tumble as crude prices retreat after U.S. halts Iran strikes
items.summary: Investing.com -- Shares in oil and gas producers across the U.S. and Europe fell sharply after the U.S. military halted two weeks of strikes on Iran, with Tehran signaling it would suspend its own attacks as long as the pause holds, easing fears of a broader Middle East escalation and dragging crude prices lower.

items.title: Chevron Is Trying to Keep Its Kazakh Assets Out of the Russia-Ukraine War
items.summary: ​The company, which has a 50% stake in a giant oil-and-gas field in Kazakhstan, spoke with U.S. officials after a Ukrainian attack hit a tanker chartered by Chevron in the Black Sea.

items.title: The Iran War Isn’t Stopping and What That Means for Chevron and Exxon Mobil
items.summary: With the Strait of Hormuz effectively shut and Brent spiking, Exxon and Chevron just reported quarters that reveal two very different bets on how this conflict ends and which major is positioned to win if it drags on.
